items.bcbs-model-risk::model-validation-indepe: The Basel Committee's model-risk guidance holds that model developers should not validate their own models: every material model needs review by a validation function independent of model development and use. AI and machine-learning models used in banking are models in this sense, so the independence expectation travels with them across the model lifecycle.
items.bcbs-model-risk::ai-ml-governance-oversi: The Basel Committee is conducting ongoing work on artificial intelligence and machine learning in banking, covering model governance, validation and risk-management practices for AI/ML models. The Committee's existing governance and risk-management principles apply in the meantime, and banks are expected to keep track of the further guidance as it is issued.
